blocking.title: Implementation is 3 of 26 chunks complete; impl-status.json has complete == false
blocking.evidence: impl-status.json: complete=false, done_items=3, total_items=26, current_chunk="4. taxonomy/: slug(), LABEL_RE, RESERVED_LABELS and the static name tables". docs/IMPL-PLAN.md checkbox counts agree: 3 checked, 23 unchecked. docs/test-report.md captures a real run of `uv run pytest tests/e2e -v`: 7 collected, 7 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 — all 7 from tests/e2e/test_cli_surface.py, all --help assertions only. src/animal_classifier/ contains __init__.py, cli.py (scaffold), errors.py, config.py, catalog.py.
blocking.what_is_wrong: Approval requires complete == true. 23 of 26 plan chunks are unwritten and the e2e suite covers only the CLI surface, so no behavioural guarantee in DESIGN.md has executable proof yet — including DEFECT 1's idempotency fix, which landed this iteration but is asserted by source reading, not by an observed second run. This is a sequencing finding, not a defect in the diff: nothing in catalog.py, errors.py, config.py, pyproject.toml or tests/e2e/ needs to be undone or revisited.
blocking.what_correct_looks_like: Continue from chunk 4 (taxonomy/) through chunk 26 of docs/IMPL-PLAN.md, updating done_items and current_chunk after each, and set complete: true only when all 26 checklist items are checked AND `uv run --frozen pytest tests/e2e -q` is green over E1-E26 with real captured output in docs/test-report.md. Gates still entirely unproven: chunk 9 must land E6's full form (a real `classify` over the fixture card proving dominance_ratio decides alone), E22 (fail-loud config), and the second-run-is-a-clean-no-op test that finally exercises record_skip's ON CONFLICT(path) upsert end to end; chunk 11 brings materialize.py with atomic writes and the --link/--hardlink/--dry-run/--reclassify contract; chunks 15-19 bring the species and bird heads, where a low-confidence result must file as `unknown` rather than a guessed species and output directories must be human-readable slugs (chuck_wills_widow, never 022_chuck_will_widow). Before writing chunk 5, read follow-up F1 in docs/FOLLOWUPS.md: ensure_image's upsert refreshes status/run_id and defaults to PLANNED, so an unconditional call from the scanner would reset done rows to planned and defeat the no-op invariant from the caller side.

notes: Iteration 2 diff reviewed by reading f682087..HEAD (catalog.py new at 1038 lines, errors.py +CatalogLockedError, config.py symlink fix, pyproject.toml dependency-group move, tests/e2e/{conftest,test_cli_surface}.py, docs). The suite was NOT re-run; the code and e2e steps' captured output was used.

Both mediums filed by iteration 1 were fixed early, ahead of their chunk-11 and chunk-9 deadlines: _resolve_without_requiring_existence now uses Path(path).resolve() so a symlinked output_root cannot evade _guard_nesting (FOLLOWUPS.md records a real rejection run), and pytest==9.1.1 moved to PEP 735 [dependency-groups] so `uv run --frozen pytest tests/e2e -q` resolves on a clean machine.

Invariant I2 (no area floor) is clean AND now executably guarded. `grep -rniE 'min_box_area|min_area|area_floor|min_animal_area|min_box_frac'` over src/ and tests/ matches only prose asserting absence (config.py:14) and the denylist in tests/e2e/test_cli_surface.py. `grep -rnE 'area_frac\s*[<>]'` returns zero matches — no box area is compared to anything. catalog.py stores area_frac on boxes for the GUI and the dominance audit trail and its BoxWrite docstring states it is never compared against a floor.

DEFECT 1's fix is present and structured so it cannot be quietly undone: SKIPPED_UPSERT_SQL (catalog.py:189-197) is INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(path) DO UPDATE; record_skip is documented as the only sanctioned write path into `skipped`; `grep -rn 'INSERT INTO skipped' src/` finds exactly one statement, the named constant. sources gets the same treatment via SOURCES_UPSERT_SQL. replace_inference deletes candidates then boxes for the hash before re-inserting inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE, so a re-classified hash cannot accumulate boxes. ensure_image excludes first_seen from its DO UPDATE list.

Fail-loud holds (I7): start_run rejects an empty source_root instead of storing '' into a NOT NULL column; ensure_image/update_image validate keywords against UPDATABLE_IMAGE_COLUMNS and raise on an unknown column rather than updating nothing; update_image and replace_inference both raise on cursor.rowcount == 0 so a write against a missing row is an error, not a silent success; _check_schema_version refuses a newer schema untouched, refuses a non-numeric version, and refuses a read-only open of a file with no schema_version row rather than presenting an empty DB. The only default in the module (status=PLANNED for a new row) is a documented new-row default, not a stand-in for a missing required value.

Read-only-card intent respected: nothing in this diff writes to a source path. Catalog.open only creates path.parent, which lives under output_root. The config.py symlink-resolution fix strengthens the guard.

Label precedence (I6) respected: replace_inference never touches overrides and never sets label_source, so a human label survives --reclassify unless a caller explicitly demotes it; insert_override only appends and nothing in the module deletes or rewrites an override row.

Lock contention is a per-image outcome, per §5.9: do_write retries 0.5/1/2/4/8 s then raises CatalogLockedError, which carries exit_code = EXIT_PARTIAL (4) and is deliberately not a CatalogError. write_tx takes the lock up front with BEGIN IMMEDIATE, which is what makes retrying the whole body sound.

e2e-only rule respected. tests/ holds exactly two .py files, both under tests/e2e/; pyproject.toml pins testpaths = ["tests/e2e"]; zero unit tests exist. The new tests are genuinely end-to-end: run_cli invokes the installed animal-classifier console script as a subprocess and asserts on stdout and exit code, and the cli_path fixture raises rather than falling back to `python -m`, which would silently test a different surface.

The test report is honest about its own scope and that is correct behaviour, not a 'green without evidence' violation: it states in as many words that the run proves nothing about detection, the dominance rule, materialization, the catalog, the GUI, training or the bird providers. Consequence recorded plainly — every correctness claim about catalog.py in this review rests on source reading until chunk 9's classify test lands.

Not yet reachable and not pre-violated by this diff: taxonomy slugs (chunk 4), atomic writes and the --link/--hardlink/--dry-run/--reclassify contract (chunk 11), unknown-vs-guessed-species (chunks 15-19). No code in this diff creates an output directory or writes an image.

FOLLOWUP F1 (high priority, act on it in chunk 5): ensure_image (catalog.py:~660-700) upserts with status and run_id in its DO UPDATE list and defaults status=PLANNED. An unconditional call from chunk 5's scanner would reset every `done` row to `planned` on a second walk, and plan_disposition decides SKIP_DONE purely from row.status — defeating the clean-no-op invariant from the caller side rather than via the skipped table. No caller exists today (grep for ensure_image outside catalog.py returns nothing), so nothing is broken now. Either consult plan_disposition before calling ensure_image, or make status/run_id refreshable only via an explicit opt-in argument; chunk 9's idempotency test must cover it.

FOLLOWUP F2 (low): write_tx's except branch issues ROLLBACK unconditionally (catalog.py:~470-480). If SQLite already rolled back, that ROLLBACK raises 'cannot rollback - no transaction is active' and masks the original exception.

FOLLOWUP F3 (low, GUI-facing): read accessors are inconsistent — image()/run()/newest_run() return frozen value objects while boxes()/candidates()/newest_override() return raw sqlite3.Row. Decide before the GUI serializers in chunks 20-22 so row-index access does not leak into the web layer.

FOLLOWUP F4 (nit): update_run_counts returns silently when every count argument is None, so a caller that passes nothing gets a successful no-op. Defensible for an all-optional progress publisher; recorded so it is a decision.

FOLLOWUP F5 (nit): runs.state has no CHECK constraint, unlike images.status and images.label_source, so RunState is enforced only in Python. Faithful to §5.9, which declares the column without enumerating values — not drift.

FOLLOWUP F6 (carried over, still open): _load_toml's injected-env branch duplicates config_search_paths() and drops its XDG_CONFIG_HOME == ~/.config dedupe (config.py:322-340). Unchanged this iteration.

All non-blocking observations are appended to docs/FOLLOWUPS.md. Per the anti-stall rule none of them withholds approval; B1 (incomplete checklist, complete == false) is the sole reason the verdict is not APPROVED.
